entities.summary: Dean Drako  is an American businessman and entrepreneur who has founded more than six companies. Drako was founder, president and CEO of Barracuda Networks from 2003 to July 2012. He is currently owner and CEO of Brivo, and co-founder and CEO of IC Manage and Drako Motors. He is also owner and chairman of Cobalt AI.
